subject: Russia's Rodina party has asked the Supreme Court to remove the opposition Yabloko party from the ballot
posts: Nationalist forces move to clear the field by legal decree. Russia's Rodina party seeks to ban Yabloko from the Duma race. Evidence: Nationalist duty, Political suppression, State-sanctioned exclusion. #Russia #Politics 🌐

In reality, this is a coordinated effort by state-aligned parties to eliminate the only anti-war voice on the ballot, using the judiciary to bypass voter choice. Resulting Judgement: (-1.5, -1.5) — Greater Evil

The Rodina party, supported by other pro-state factions, filed a lawsuit with the Supreme Court to disqualify Yabloko, the only party openly opposing the war, just days after their registration.

The move effectively removes the last remaining legal avenue for anti-war voters to express dissent, forcing them into total political silence.

The error is in the WHO plane; they claim to protect the state, but they are actually protecting their own power by removing the only alternative.

This is a classic power-hoarding loop. By framing political opposition as a lack of patriotism, they create a pretext to justify the removal of rivals, projecting their own insecurity onto the opposition.
